# drivr

**A coordination daemon that rents both halves.**

drivr coordinates work across the fleet. It **rents** both chat and execution: it invokes CLI
tools that own the inference, and spends its own budget on coordination over governance state.

It implements **no inference, no model loop, no engine, and no agent client.** That is the
project's spine (SN-27), stated as an exclusion so it cannot erode by increment, and it is
enforced where it is cheapest to check — the dependency list in [`requirements.txt`](requirements.txt).

# drivr

**A coordination daemon that rents both halves.**

drivr coordinates work across the fleet. It **rents** both chat and execution: it invokes CLI
tools that own the inference, and spends its own budget on coordination over governance state.

It implements **no inference, no model loop, no engine, and no agent client.** That is the
project's spine (SN-27), stated as an exclusion so it cannot erode by increment, and it is
enforced where it is cheapest to check — the dependency list in [`requirements.txt`](requirements.txt).

---

## Status: inception

This repository was created by Epic **P11-M38-E38.1** of the
[AI Project System](https://github.com/panchew/ai-project-system) and is **deliberately empty of
behaviour.** There is no coordination logic, no config loader, no CLI entry point, and no
execution adapter here, because each belongs to an epic that has more information than E38.1 did:

| Not here | Owner |
|---|---|
| The execution adapter surface and the OpenCode adapter | **E38.2** |
| The fleet registry, the classification pass, the `.ai-project.yml` validator | **E38.3** |
| The completion signal (`P10-GH-7`) | **M39** |
| The scheduler, the derived gate queue, the thin surface | **M40** |

An empty, governed, tested, confirmable repository is the correct outcome of inception.

## Governance

drivr is enrolled under the AI Project System framework. See [`.ai-project.yml`](.ai-project.yml) —
every field in it is annotated with why it is there, including the four fields
`bin/ai-project-init` does not write and the one it writes invalidly.

- **Governance corpus:** the `.governance/` submodule, pinned to `v7.1.0`
  (commit `bb727a52678b86df3bf5eac1a56eead5fec7bd9c`)
- **`framework_version`:** `v7.1.0` — **convention-only at the time of writing**; the field has no
  entry in `ai-project-yml-spec.md` (carried as `P10-GH-1`, folded in by E38.3)
- **Installed agent:** `.ai-project/agents/governance.agent.md`, canonical, sha256 `66404389…`

> **The submodule path is `.governance`, per fleet convention.** `bin/ai-project-init` produces
> `governance/` and hard-codes it with no flag to change it; the tool was **not** modified — the
> defect is recorded and escalated.

## Development

**Requires Python 3.** Runtime dependency: PyYAML. Development adds pytest.

```sh
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
```

### Running the tests

```sh
pytest
```

From the repository root, with no environment variables and no `PYTHONPATH` incantation — that is
deliberate, and `pyproject.toml` says why. The vendored `.governance/` submodule carries its own
large suite and is excluded from collection, so this number is always drivr's own.

**Baseline at inception (2026-08-10): 2 passed.**
